pictures.scene: Bouguereau, The Holy Women at the Tomb — three women in heavy black mourning robes crowded at the opening of a rock cut tomb, the great squared stone doorway and its lintel filling the whole picture behind them, one kneeling in front with a dark veil over her hair and a dull red sleeve showing, her hands clasped up under her chin and her face lifted wide eyed, another standing above her in a long black mantle with her hand pressed to her forehead and her eyes staring down, her bare feet on the step, a third kneeling at the right seen from behind in a pale olive veil that covers her head and shoulders, one hand flung out against the wall and a wide brass dish of spices tipped in the other, and through the low doorway beside her a burst of white light with a young angel in a white robe sitting in it, one arm raised, on the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared, they found the stone rolled away from the tomb, …
pictures.name: pd_bouguereau_de_heilige_vrouwen_bij_het_graf

pictures.scene: Perugino, The Archangel Michael — a young armoured angel standing alone and filling the whole arched panel, a thin gold halo ringing his head, a black cap with a long coral ribbon knotted round it set over his loose fair curls, his face smooth and unsmiling and turned a little aside, two huge brown feathered wings spread wide behind his shoulders, his body cased from throat to foot in polished steel plate with red leather buckles down the arms, a sword hanging at his hip, a slender staff held level across him in his bare right hand, a tall shield with an orange scrolled border and a blue medallion standing on the ground in front of his legs, a pair of brass scales hanging from a stake at the left, and behind him a quiet green plain with small trees running back to a pale horizon, while they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them, as the women bowed their faces to the ground in terror, …
pictures.name: pd_perugino_engelen

pictures.scene: Carracci, The Holy Women at the Tomb — two women halted on rough stony ground outside a tomb under heavy dark trees, the first standing full height in a scarlet dress with a deep blue mantle drawn up over her head, barefoot on the step, one hand flung up open and the other raised flat against her breast, her mouth open and her face turned sharply round as if she has just been spoken to, the second swinging past her in a great white grey cloak over a dark green gown, bent forward with her weight on one sandalled foot, a white headcloth wound round her hair, her face in clean profile and her eyes dropped, her arm reaching out of a gold yellow sleeve with the fingers spread wide, a third woman in yellow and a red sleeve pressed in at the far edge behind them, and away below at the left a pale strip of sky over a dim walled town with two tiny horsemen riding in the dark, he is not here, he has risen, remember how he told you while he was still in galilee, …
pictures.name: pd_carracci_holy_women_at_the_tomb

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Saint Peter Preaching — a fresco of a white bearded apostle standing barefoot at the left in a pale blue tunic under a great orange cloak, his right hand lifted with two fingers raised and his head turned down toward the people, a thin gold halo behind his hair, and packed against him a crowd of listeners, a woman in a dark blue hood kneeling with her chin lifted and her eyes wide, an old man in a rose red cloak kneeling beside her with his white beard laid on his chest and his eyes closed, a young woman leaning her cheek on her hand behind them, a row of men in caps and hoods pressed shoulder to shoulder with every face turned the same way, two monks in white and dark green habits standing tall at the right edge, and behind them all a green mountain with small dark trees scattered up its slopes, then they remembered his words, and when they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the eleven and to all the others, …
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_saint_peter_preaching

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Two Old Men Disputing — two old men close together in a dark brown room with shadow filling the whole upper part of the picture, one sitting back in a wooden armchair in a loose white robe, bald on top with thin grey hair and a long white beard spread over his chest, his eyes fixed hard on the other man and one hand laid open on the book in his lap, the other man seen from behind in a heavy brown cloak over a dull red sleeve with only the back of his grey head and the edge of his cheek showing, his bare foot pushed forward on the floor and his hand pressing a page flat while the leaves of a thick open book fan up under his fingers, and behind them in the gloom a table with a brass candlestick and a second book lying on it, but their words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women, …
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_two_old_men

pictures.scene: Burnand, The Disciples Running to the Tomb — two men caught mid stride against a dawn sky of pale yellow and violet cloud, both leaning hard forward with the wind dragging their clothes back, the younger at the left in a white robe with dark red hair blown off his forehead, his mouth open and his eyes fixed far ahead, his hands clasped tight together in front of his chest as he runs, the older beside him in a rust brown cloak with a dark blue wrap over the shoulder, grey curls and a heavy grizzled beard, deep lines cut across his forehead and his eyes wide and anxious, one hand gripping the cloak at his breast and the other hanging open at his side, and a bare strip of track and a green field showing low down behind them, peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb, …
pictures.name: pd_burnand_disciples_running_colour

pictures.scene: Melone, On the Road to Emmaus — two men walking a dusty road below a hill town, both barefoot and full height, the older at the left bald on top with a long grey beard, in a pale blue tunic under a great orange cloak falling in heavy folds to his feet, a staff slanting across him, his head turned back over his shoulder and one hand lifted open in the middle of saying something, the younger at the right in a long green gown with a deep red and rose mantle wrapped over it, his auburn hair to his shoulders and his face turned the same way to listen, both hands caught up in the cloth, and reaching in at the very edge of the picture a hand and a dark sleeve that have just been laid on the older man's shoulder, with walls and towers climbing the hill behind them and four small figures standing together on the slope, they were talking with each other about everything that had happened, and as they talked and deliberated, jesus himself came up and walked along with them, …
pictures.name: pd_melone_wandelt

pictures.scene: Friedrich, Two Men Contemplating the Moon — two men in long dark green overcoats stopped on a steep woodland path at dusk, seen from behind so that neither face shows, the one at the left in a flat cap leaning in close with his hand laid on the other's shoulder, the taller in a tall fur cap with a walking staff planted beside him and a cloak hanging over his arm, both standing quite still and looking away out of the picture, a great old tree leaning right across the top with its bare twisting branches and dry hanging moss spread over the whole sky, the gnarled roots of another torn out of the bank at their feet, loose rocks and dry grass along the path, and low over the far ground a thin crescent moon burning in a soft warm haze of gold, but their eyes were kept from recognizing him, they stood still, with sadness on their faces, …
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_two_men_contemplating_the_moon

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — a huge crowd packed into a dark wood to hear one man, the preacher standing well back among them in a rough brown robe with long hair and a beard, one hand raised and the other pointing away through the trees, and in front of him hundreds of listeners crammed shoulder to shoulder up the slope, countrymen in black hats and hoods, women in white linen caps, a man in a pale yellow cloak with his face lifted, a woman in pink with her hands folded, a child in an orange coat carried on someone's shoulders, pedlars with baskets and a pilgrim's shell, a red banner hanging against a tree trunk at the left, two men climbed up into the branches overhead to see over the crowd, and in the near corner the broad backs of those at the edge of it, this man was a prophet, powerful in speech and action before god and all the people, …
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_sermon_of_saint_john_the_baptist

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, Sorrowing Old Man — an old man sitting doubled over on a plain wooden chair in the corner of a bare room, dressed head to foot in a worn blue workman's jacket and trousers painted in long dragged strokes, his white hair cut short and showing yellow in the light, both fists pressed hard against his eyes and his elbows driven down onto his knees so that his face is hidden altogether, heavy brown boots planted wide apart on a scrubbed plank floor, the red chair standing out sharp behind him, a fire glowing in the corner at the left, and nothing else in the room at all, but we were hoping he was the one who would redeem israel, …
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_sorrowing_old_man

pictures.scene: Thayer, Angel — a young girl standing straight in front of us and filling the whole picture, two great white wings spread wide open behind her from edge to edge with every feather softly brushed in, a narrow band of pale blue showing between them above her head, her dark brown hair falling loose to her jaw, her face calm and serious and lit full on, her wide grey eyes looking steadily out at you, a plain white sleeveless gown gathered at the waist and falling in heavy folds, her arms hanging quietly at her sides, and nothing else in the picture but the white of the wings, they came and told us they had seen a vision of angels, who said that jesus was alive, …
pictures.name: pd_thayer_angel

pictures.scene: Tissot, The Watch Over the Tomb — a square stone doorway cut into a bare hillside with a round sealing stone pushed across it, a cord and seal hanging down the middle of the opening, and a company of guards posted all round it through the night, two stretched out asleep along the top of the lintel, a soldier standing inside the doorway in a helmet and a short tunic leaning on his spear with his hand to his face, a man in a white turban slumped against the stone beside him and another curled over asleep at his feet, two more sitting on the bank at the left with their elbows on their knees, one rubbing his eyes under a white headcloth, a man wrapped in a grey cloak asleep in the near corner with his head fallen forward, spears and blankets dropped on the ground, two square lanterns hanging from the rock giving the only light, and a pale strip of dawn sky over the ridge, then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had described, but him they did not see, …
pictures.name: pd_tissot_watch_over_tomb

pictures.scene: Champaigne, Moses with the Ten Commandments — an old prophet filling the whole picture out of a black ground, his long fair hair and a thick curling grey beard spread over his chest, two small dark horns of light standing up from his forehead, deep lines cut across his brow, his lips parted and his eyes turned sharply aside as if he had just been spoken to, a heavy blue velvet mantle over a gold embroidered robe with a jewelled clasp at the shoulder, a pink frilled cuff at his wrist, a long gilt rod laid diagonally across him, his bare right hand resting flat on a stone ledge in front, and held upright against him a tall grey stone tablet covered in close handwriting, the commandments numbered four to ten running down it one under another, honour your father and mother, you shall not kill, you shall not steal, you shall not bear false witness, with the edge of the second tablet showing behind it, and beginning with moses and all the prophets, he explained to them what was written in all the scriptures about himself, …
pictures.name: pd_champaigne_moses_with_the_ten_commandments

pictures.scene: Schikaneder, Evening Street — a narrow old town street at nightfall with tall plastered houses rising the whole height of the picture, their walls grey green and worn, a steep red tiled roof and a line of snow lying along the cornices, lamplight burning yellow behind one upper window and three more windows glowing deep orange further along, a dark archway opening at the left and a shuttered shop front lit red at the right, a faint painted sign over the doorway, a woman walking slowly along the empty pavement toward us, small against the great wall of houses, a white cloth tied over her head and a dull red shawl wrapped round her shoulders over a long grey skirt, her head bent and her hands folded in front of her, another figure in pale clothes disappearing into the archway behind her, and the wide cold cobbles stretching away empty in front, stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over, so he went in to stay with them, …
pictures.name: pd_schikaneder_avondstraat

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Supper at Emmaus — a young beardless Christ seated at the middle of a white clothed table in a dim brown room, His long dark hair falling in waves past His shoulders, His face lit full on and His eyes lowered toward the bread, His right hand lifted wide open in blessing so that it throws a great shadow on the wall behind Him, His left hand coming forward over the cloth, a scarlet tunic under a creamy white mantle gathered at the waist, an old man at the right leaning in with his bald head and grey beard turned toward Him and both hands raised in astonishment, the sleeve and gesturing hand of a second man pressing in at the left edge, and spread across the table in front of them a roast bird on a painted dish, a torn loaf, a glass of dark wine, and a wicker basket of grapes, figs, pomegranates and apples tipped over the very edge, with a heavy patterned carpet hanging down the front of the table, while he was reclining at the table with them, he took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to them, …
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_supper_at_emmaus

pictures.scene: Church, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the whole walled city seen from across the valley in a warm golden haze, a great tower of pale cloud piled up the left of the sky and lit from within, the long battlemented wall running right across the picture with a sealed gateway in it, the domes and flat roofs and minarets of the old city packed behind, a dark blue green dome standing over its white paved court, cypresses and a line of green grass along the top of the wall, the dry olive planted slopes of the valley falling away below in deep shadow, a small white domed tomb on the far hillside, and in the near foreground a rough chalk track covered in loose stones where two travellers have stopped, one riding a laden camel with a second camel behind, a boy in an orange coat walking at its head and a man in a blue robe and red cap standing beside them, their long shadows thrown across the rock, with an olive tree leaning in over the path at the right, and they got up that very hour and returned to jerusalem, …
pictures.name: pd_church_jerusalem_from_the_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Tears of Saint Peter — a grey haired old fisherman standing close to us against a dark rock face, filling the whole picture, his hair and short curling beard silver, his forehead furrowed and his head tilted back, his eyes brimming and turned up and away to the light with the lids reddened, his mouth a little open, a great mantle of deep yellow wrapped across his body and over his left shoulder with a blue green cloak falling from the other, his two weathered hands clasped tightly together in front of his chest and his bare forearms crossed below them, two heavy iron keys hanging at his side, sprays of ivy with pale veined leaves hanging over the rock above him on either side, and far off at the left a small bright opening where a woman in white hurries away from an empty tomb, the lord has indeed risen and has appeared to simon, …
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_tears_of_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Bloch, The Resurrection — the risen Christ standing full height in the mouth of a dark rock tomb, a ring of golden light burning round His head, His dark hair and short beard falling to His shoulders, His face lifted and His eyes raised, both arms flung wide and high with the palms open, a long cream white robe falling from His left shoulder in heavy straight folds to His bare feet and a sash crossing His body, the pale stone slab He has risen from lying broken open on the ground in front of Him with its lid toppled sideways, white lilies springing up on either side of the tomb, and two young angels in plain white gowns kneeling at the left and the right with their fair hair bound up, their hands pressed together and their faces turned in toward Him, jesus himself stood among them and said, peace be with you, …
pictures.name: pd_bloch_resurrection

pictures.scene: Garofalo, Christ Washing the Disciples' Feet — a company of men gathered along a panelled stone wall in a hall, Christ kneeling low in front of them in a deep red robe with a white cloth wrapped over His shoulder and knotted at His waist, a fine rayed gold halo round His fair head, His own hands down in the water holding the bare foot of a grey bearded man and pouring from a jug so the water splashes into a wide brass basin on the floor, the old man sitting above Him in a blue tunic and an orange yellow mantle with one bare leg drawn up and one laid on the ground, his hand pressed flat to his chest and his face bent down in protest, behind them a white haired apostle in green, another with long hair leaning in, a young fair disciple in red pointing down at the basin, every head ringed with a thin gold line, and in front of them all the pale stone floor with a bare foot at the very edge, look at my hands and my feet, it is i myself, …
pictures.name: pd_garofalo_christ_washing_the_disciples_feet

pictures.scene: Chardin, Grace Before the Meal — a quiet brown kitchen room where a mother is setting the dinner down for her two small children, the woman standing at the right and leaning over the table in a rust brown jacket with wide turned back cuffs, a long grey blue apron and a white kerchief crossed at her breast, a white cap tied over her hair, her eyes lowered to the dish she is still holding, a shallow steaming bowl set in front of her on a plain white cloth with two more plates, a spoon and a knife laid out, the elder child sitting across the table in a tall striped armchair in a pale yellow dress and a white cap with a blue ribbon, her hands on the cloth and her face turned up toward her mother, the smaller child kneeling on a low chair in the near corner with her back to us in a cream dress with a red sash and a red cap, one hand lifted and her face in profile, a little copper pan standing on the tiled floor at the right, and a bare wall rising quietly behind them all, he asked them, do you have anything here to eat, …
pictures.name: pd_chardin_benedicite

pictures.scene: Van Beijeren, Still Life with Fish — a heap of fresh caught fish piled in a wide wicker basket on a kitchen table in a dark room, a big grey sea fish lying across the top with its scales still wet and its round black eye catching the light, two more silver fish laid under it with their bellies pale and their fins spread, a long cut of salmon beside them showing deep orange red flesh and white bands, another fish hanging over the far edge of the basket, a crumpled green grey cloth pulled across the table in front, a knife with a pale bone handle lying at the left, a wooden board hanging from an iron hook on the wall behind, and a copper pot standing in the shadow, so they gave him a piece of broiled fish, and he took it and ate it in front of them, …
pictures.name: pd_beijeren_stilleven_met_vissen

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Apostle Paul — an old apostle sitting alone at his writing desk in a dark brown room, turned a little aside with his head propped on his left hand, the fingers pushed up into his grey brown hair, his forehead creased and his lips parted as he thinks, a long grizzled beard falling over his chest, the light coming from the side across his cheek and his bare working hands, a heavy dark olive mantle hanging over him with a torn red undersleeve showing at each wrist, his right hand resting low in his lap still holding a long white quill, an open book lying across his knees under the folds of the cloak, a thick volume propped on the sloping desk at the right with its pages catching the light, the carved arm of his wooden chair behind him and the hilt of a sword showing beyond it, everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the law of moses, the prophets, and the psalms, then he opened their minds to understand the scriptures, …
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_apostle_paul

pictures.scene: Raphael, Saint Paul Preaching at Athens — a bearded apostle standing on the top step of a great stone platform in a Greek city, seen from behind and a little to the side with a thin gold halo round his dark curling head, his face turned in profile and his mouth open in mid sentence, both arms thrown up and the palms spread open above him, a pale green tunic on his back under a long salmon red mantle that falls in heavy folds all the way to his bare feet, and all round him the people who have come to hear, two older men at the left watching from a bench, one in a round red cap with his head tilted up and one with his chin propped on his fist, a young curly haired boy standing close behind him looking straight out at us, a row of seated listeners at the right in orange, green and rose robes leaning in toward him with their bare feet on the step, a tall arch and a row of fluted columns rising behind them all, and the wide pale paving of the square spreading away in front, and in his name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in jerusalem, …
pictures.name: pd_raphael_saint_paul_preaching_at_athens

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Adoration of the Lamb — a wide green flowering meadow under a pale blue sky, a white dove hanging at the very top inside a great burst of golden light with long straight rays spreading out over the whole picture, a white lamb standing on a stone altar in the middle of the field with a thin gold halo round its head, blood running from its breast into a gold cup set in front of it, the altar hung with a crimson embroidered cloth lettered in gold, crowds of angels kneeling all round it in long cream white gowns with red, blue and peacock coloured wings folded behind them, their hands pressed together and their faces lifted, two of them holding up the wooden cross and the pillar, four more kneeling nearer with censers swinging on long chains, a tall silver fountain playing into an octagonal basin in the foreground with the water running clear, a line of dark green trees and hedges across the middle distance, far off a river valley and the towers and spires of a city on the hills, and in the near corners the witnesses, a man in a blue turban and a rose coloured coat reading from an open book with his head thrown back, a white bearded man beside him over another book, and a robed figure at the right kneeling with his back to us, you are witnesses of these things, and behold, i am sending the promise of my father upon you, …
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_adoration_of_the_lamb

pictures.scene: Mantegna, The Ascension — Christ carried up into a deep blue sky scattered with small white clouds, standing upright on a little grey cloud with His bare feet together, a gold halo behind His brown hair and short beard, a heavy blue mantle wrapped over a gold striped robe, His right hand lifted with two fingers raised in blessing and His left holding a tall slender staff topped with a cross and a white banner, and all round Him an almond shaped wreath of red winged cherub heads looking in at Him out of a ring of blue grey cloud, below Him a steep tan rock cliff at the left with thin saplings growing from the ledges and a bare rounded hill at the right, and on the ground the whole company watching Him go, the mother of Jesus standing in the middle in a dark green mantle over a red dress with a white veil wound round her head and both hands lifted open, a white bearded apostle at the left holding a red book, a young one beside him in green with his head thrown right back, a man in rose shading his eyes, a kneeling figure in the near corner twisting round to look up, and a press of bearded men at the right in gold, blue grey and red cloaks all turning their faces to the sky, while he was blessing them, he left them and was carried up into heaven, …
pictures.name: pd_mantegna_ascension

pictures.scene: De Witte, Interior of the Oude Kerk in Amsterdam during a Sermon — the inside of a great whitewashed Gothic church with the service going on, tall round piers with carved leaf capitals carrying pointed arches high overhead, a row of small dark openings running along the clerestory wall, wide traceried windows at the left and in the middle filled with clear leaded glass and painted panes, three blue stained glass roundels with coats of arms set across the top of one of them, a gilded organ case and a black and gold hatchment hanging against the pier at the right, a many branched brass chandelier on a long cord, the preacher standing up in a wooden pulpit against the middle pier in a plain black gown with his hand stretched out as he speaks, the elders seated under him in tall black hats behind a long panelled oak screen with rows of listeners beyond it, and in the near foreground the people of the town, a woman in a black hood and a wide white collar reading a paper, a small child in a yellow jacket and white apron standing beside her, a man leaning on the screen, women kneeling and seated in heavy black cloaks, a brown and white spaniel sitting in the broad band of sunlight falling across the stone floor, and they worshiped him and returned to jerusalem with great joy, praising god continually in the temple, …
pictures.name: pd_de_witte_interior_of_the_oude_kerk_amsterdam_during_a_sermon

lines.text: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared.
They found the stone rolled away from the tomb, but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
While they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them.
As the women bowed their faces to the ground in terror, the two men asked them, Why do you look for the living among the dead?
He is not here; He has risen! Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee:
The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again.
Then they remembered His words.
And when they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.
It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told this to the apostles.
But their words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women.
Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. And after bending down and seeing only the linen cloths, he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.
That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.
And as they talked and deliberated, Jesus Himself came up and walked along with them.
But their eyes were kept from recognizing Him.
He asked them, What are you discussing so intently as you walk along? They stood still, with sadness on their faces.
One of them, named Cleopas, asked Him, Are You the only visitor to Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in recent days?
What things? He asked. The events involving Jesus of Nazareth, they answered. This man was a prophet, powerful in speech and action before God and all the people.
Our chief priests and rulers delivered Him up to the sentence of death, and they crucified Him.
But we were hoping He was the One who would redeem Israel. And besides all this, it is the third day since these things took place.
Furthermore, some of our women astounded us. They were at the tomb early this morning,
but they did not find His body. They came and told us they had seen a vision of angels, who said that Jesus was alive.
Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had described. But Him they did not see.
Then Jesus said to them, O foolish ones, how slow are your hearts to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then to enter His glory?
And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself.
As they approached the village where they were headed, He seemed to be going farther.
But they pleaded with Him, Stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over. So He went in to stay with them.
While He was reclining at the table with them, He took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to them.
Then their eyes were opened and they recognized Jesus, and He disappeared from their sight.
They asked each other, Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?
And they got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, gathered together
and saying, The Lord has indeed risen and has appeared to Simon!
Then the two told what had happened on the road, and how they had recognized Jesus in the breaking of the bread.
While they were describing these events, Jesus Himself stood among them and said, Peace be with you.
But they were startled and frightened, thinking they had seen a spirit.
Why are you troubled, Jesus asked, and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
Look at My hands and My feet. It is I Myself. Touch Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.
And when He had said this, He showed them His hands and feet.
While they were still in disbelief because of their joy and amazement, He asked them, Do you have anything here to eat?
So they gave Him a piece of broiled fish,
and He took it and ate it in front of them.
Jesus said to them, These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.
Then He opened their minds to understand the Scriptures.
And He told them, This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
You are witnesses of these things.
And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you. But remain in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.
When Jesus had led them out as far as Bethany, He lifted up His hands and blessed them.
While He was blessing them, He left them and was carried up into heaven.
And they worshiped Him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
praising God continually in the temple.
